request: High-detail original Chinese city-builder resources and UI buttons for Godot; true alpha, isolated 4x4 cells.
processing: Icons: alpha component extraction and 384px-cell atlas packing without upscaling. Panels: alpha component extraction plus mechanical nine-patch border normalization to 512px. Generated originals are retained; no procedural replacement artwork.
rights: Original generated assets made for this project, subject to applicable image-generation service terms. No artwork copied from 模拟帝国 or any other game.

images.prompt:
Create an original HIGH RESOLUTION professional resource icon atlas for a premium historical Chinese city-building game in Godot. EXACTLY SIXTEEN icons, a perfect regular 4 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS grid on a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Square 2048x2048 preferred, otherwise highest square resolution with each cell at least 256 pixels. Equal cells, each independent icon centered and entirely contained inside its cell, 12% clear transparent margin around every icon. No text, letters, numbers, labels, panel frames, separator lines, whole buildings or background. No drop-shadow fog, no glow, no halo. Razor-sharp clean alpha edges.
Visual direction: exceptionally fine hand-painted illustrative objects, realistic tactile material detail at a readable small-icon scale; polished historical strategy-game interface, warm bronze and antique gold highlights, deep walnut edge accents, restrained jade/teal and cinnabar colors. Objects seen in a consistent slight 2:1 isometric three-quarter view with upper-left light. Rich crafted surfaces and clear silhouettes, not flat vector icons, not emojis, not plastic mobile-game cartoons. All icons equally visually substantial.
Exact ROW-MAJOR order:
ROW 1: (1) GRAIN, a tied golden bundle of ripe rice/wheat stalks with a small heap of pale grain; (2) VEGETABLES, one fresh green napa cabbage and a small root vegetable; (3) FRUIT, a small cluster of red apples, one golden pear and green leaf; (4) FISH, two fresh silver-blue river fish with tiny subtle blue scales.
ROW 2: (5) MEAT, two clean raw red meat cuts with pale fat edge on a small plain butcher board, no blood; (6) WOOD, a compact stack of three cut timber logs, clear warm end grain; (7) STONE, a compact stack of three pale granite building blocks with sharp chiseled facets; (8) CLAY, a pile of warm ochre raw clay lumps with a small moist clay ball.
ROW 3: (9) COPPER ORE, a rough dark rock bearing bright copper metallic veins and a little malachite turquoise; (10) BRICKS, a compact neat stack of four fired red clay bricks; (11) POTTERY, two elegant ancient Chinese glazed ceramic storage jars, warm terracotta and celadon; (12) CLOTH, two rich folded cloth bolts in muted indigo and faded cinnabar tied with a cord.
ROW 4: (13) BREAD, two rustic golden baked round loaves with a cut showing their airy crumb; (14) WINE, a sealed brown ceramic wine jug with a red cloth tie and a tiny bronze drinking cup, no writing on jug; (15) GOLD, three gleaming antique Chinese gold sycee ingots with small round coins; (16) POPULATION, a friendly pair of miniature ancient Chinese adult villager portrait busts, one man and one woman, dignified ordinary people in jade and ochre cloth clothing.
Every resource clearly distinguishable, all 16 complete icons, no missing cells. Standalone transparent game interface artwork, no external game copied.

Using the provided image ONLY as the exact visual style reference for matching the bronze edging, dark walnut wood plaques, lighting, antique gold relief and corner shapes, create a NEW original complementary UI button atlas. DO NOT repeat the reference symbols. True transparent background outside every plaque. Exactly SIXTEEN buttons in a perfectly regular 4x4 grid, square highest resolution, 2048x2048 preferred, generous transparent gutters. All button plaques identical size and border thickness and match the reference set. No captions, words, numbers, letter labels, extra icons or background. No glow or hazy shadows. Crisp hand-painted finely crafted historical Chinese city-builder UI, gold and bronze raised pictorial symbols on dark wooden square plaques, front view. Symbols large and readable.
EXACT ROW-MAJOR CONTENT:
ROW 1: (1) PAUSE: two thick vertical antique gold bars side by side; (2) PLAY: one large antique gold triangular play arrow pointing RIGHT; (3) SETTINGS: an intricate but clearly recognizable bronze gear wheel with a jade central hub; (4) HELP: a large gold QUESTION MARK glyph with a gold dot below, only this single pictorial glyph, no other writing.
ROW 2: (5) MOVE: four short gold arrows pointing outward up down left right from a central jade diamond; (6) CONFIRM: one very large strong gold checkmark; (7) TRADE: two gold arrows forming opposite directions above a small pair of ancient coins and a tied trade pouch; (8) EXPORT: a gold arrow pointing diagonally UP AND RIGHT out of an open bronze-edged square container.
ROW 3: (9) IMPORT: a gold arrow pointing diagonally DOWN AND LEFT INTO a bronze-edged square container; (10) NEW CITY: a tiny Chinese jade-roof gatehouse with a bold gold PLUS beside it; (11) CHECKBOX ON: an inset square bronze checkbox containing a large gold checkmark, muted jade inner field; (12) CHECKBOX OFF: the same inset square bronze checkbox EMPTY with dark inner field, clearly visible frame, no glyph inside.
ROW 4: (13) WATER COVERAGE: a large clear jade-blue water droplet over a tiny stylized gold map tile; (14) POLLUTION COVERAGE: a small ancient kiln chimney with a charcoal-grey smoke plume over a tiny bronze map tile, a restrained rust-red accent, no skulls; (15) SPEED: two large strong gold right-pointing chevrons side by side like fast-forward; (16) LOCK: a single large closed antique bronze padlock with a gold shackle.
Every button a complete isolated square plaque, matching the provided first atlas stylistically, independently usable. Only these sixteen symbols in this exact order.

Generate one ORIGINAL professional 2x2 atlas of FOUR blank nine-slice interface panel textures for a high-detail historical Chinese city-building game. Square highest resolution, 2048x2048 preferred. Exactly FOUR large equal-sized perfectly square FLAT FRONT-VIEW panels in a strict 2 columns by 2 rows layout. Each panel at least 512x512 pixels. TRUE TRANSPARENT background in the generous gutters OUTSIDE every complete panel; opaque material INSIDE each panel. All panels perfectly upright, no perspective or isometric tilt, no cast shadows, no background scene. Match exquisite aged bronze, dark walnut and antique warm gold historical Chinese interface craft. NO icons, NO symbols, NO calligraphy, NO text, NO numbers, NO paintings in the center.
IMPORTANT nine-slice design constraint: decorative border/corner detail must remain within a narrow band no wider than about 5% of each panel width (approximately 24-32px for a 600px panel). All FOUR corners fully contained. The long straight edge strips have uniform thickness and a repeatable small grain; NO ornaments extending far inward. The very large center should have quiet uniform material with gentle microscopic grain, no large stains or gradients or central decoration, so it can stretch and tile beneath readable text. Flat framing, small elegant beveled edge, precise pixels, no rounded bulbous toys.
EXACT POSITIONS:
TOP LEFT: a warm ivory Chinese xuan paper panel. Cream/buff fine visible fiber paper center, delicate thin antique-bronze perimeter with tiny tasteful engraved metal corner guards, fine tactile edge. Mostly light paper, sophisticated simple artisan frame.
TOP RIGHT: a deep dark walnut wood panel. Very subtle narrow wood grain center, a slender dark carved timber perimeter and very thin muted gold inlay. Minimal traditional geometric carving confined to the narrow frame, no big ornate swirls and no corner posts. Rich realistic wood, suitable under pale interface text.
BOTTOM LEFT: a paler ivory paper BUTTON CARD. Almost plain luminous cream center with extremely subtle fine paper fiber. Slim clean double bronze hairline perimeter and tiny subdued gold chamfered corner accents. Noticeably lighter and simpler than top left, suitable for both thin horizontal buttons and small card panels.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a deep cinnabar RED LACQUER BUTTON CARD. Quiet uniform rich muted red lacquer center with fine artisanal surface, thin elegant antique-gold edge and minuscule engraved corner joints. Suitable for confirmation/highlight buttons, no writing, no seals.
Generate all four complete standalone objects, clean alpha around outlines. These are raw NINE-PATCH MATERIALS, not a composed interface screenshot. Crisp hand-painted material realism, softly lit consistently from upper left, intentional subtle material depth, no excessive ornaments. Do not add a fifth panel. Do not imitate any existing game artwork.
